entra.label: Microsoft Entra ID (Office 365)
entra.description: Reads the users and groups of your Microsoft tenant, read-only, with an application registered in Entra (User.Read.All, Group.Read.All and GroupMember.Read.All permissions of type Application, with administrator consent).

tenant_id.label: Tenant ID
tenant_id.help: The identifier of your Microsoft directory. Entra → Overview → "Tenant ID" (or your .onmicrosoft.com domain name).

client_id.label: Application (client) ID
client_id.help: The identifier of the application you registered: Entra → App registrations → your application → "Application (client) ID". It is neither the object ID nor the secret ID.

team_selector.label: Where does the team name come from?
team_selector.help: Teams (accounting, HR, purchasing…) let you target a campaign in one go. They can come from the directory's groups, or from a field filled in on each person (their department, their organizational unit…).

team_attribute.label: Attribute that gives the team
team_attribute.help: The field of each Entra user whose value is the team name. Used if you chose "an attribute" or "both".

secret.label: Client secret
secret.help: The VALUE of the secret created in Entra → Certificates & secrets (the "Value" column, not "Secret ID"). It is shown only once at creation; here it is encrypted and never displayed again.

google.label: Google Workspace
google.description: Reads the users and groups of your Google domain, read-only, with a service account authorized through domain-wide delegation (Google Cloud and Admin consoles).

admin_email.label: An administrator's email
admin_email.help: The address of a Google Workspace administrator on whose behalf the service account reads the directory (domain-wide delegation).

team_selector.label: Where does the team name come from?
team_selector.help: Teams (accounting, HR, purchasing…) let you target a campaign in one go. They can come from the directory's groups, or from a field filled in on each person (their department, their organizational unit…).

team_attribute.label: Attribute that gives the team
team_attribute.help: What is used as the team name for each person: their organizational unit (OU) in the Admin console, or their "Department" field. Used if you chose "an attribute" or "both".

secret.label: Service account key (JSON)
secret.help: The content of the JSON file downloaded from Google Cloud (IAM → Service accounts → Keys → Create key). It contains "client_email" and "private_key". Encrypted here, never displayed again.

guide.0: Google Cloud console (console.cloud.google.com): pick or create a project, then "APIs & Services" → "Library" → enable "Admin SDK API".
guide.1: "IAM & Admin" → "Service accounts" → "Create service account" (for example lcit-sign-directory). No role needs to be granted in Google Cloud.
guide.2: Open that account → "Keys" tab → "Add key" → "Create new key" → JSON. Paste the content of the downloaded file into "Service account key" below.
guide.3: Note the service account's "Client ID" (a long number, on its details page, "Advanced settings" or "Details").
guide.4: Admin console (admin.google.com), with a super administrator: "Security" → "Access and data control" → "API controls" → "Manage domain-wide delegation" → "Add new". Enter the client ID noted in step 4 and, as OAuth scopes (comma-separated): https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.user.readonly,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.group.readonly,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/admin.directory.group.member.readonly
guide.5: Below, "An administrator's email": the address of a super administrator of the domain (an account dedicated to reading the directory is preferable). The service account reads the directory on their behalf, read-only; nothing is modified.
guide.6: Save, then run a synchronization. If Google answers "unauthorized_client": step 5 is not yet taken into account (a few minutes) or a scope was copied wrongly. If key creation is refused in step 3, a policy of your organization forbids it: ask its administrator to allow it.

ldap.label: LDAP / Active Directory
ldap.description: Reads the users and groups of an LDAP directory (OpenLDAP, 389 DS, Active Directory…) with a read-only service account. The connection is encrypted and the server certificate is always verified.

server_url.label: Server address
server_url.help: The directory's address. ldaps:// (port 636) encrypts the connection; ldap:// (port 389) is only accepted with StartTLS.

start_tls.label: StartTLS
start_tls.help: Encrypt an ldap:// connection with StartTLS (not needed with ldaps://).

bind_dn.label: Bind account (DN)
bind_dn.help: The DN of the read-only service account LCIT Sign uses to read the directory. The password is entered below.

base_dn.label: Search base (DN)
base_dn.help: The point of the directory from which to search for people and groups.

user_filter.label: People filter
user_filter.help: Which entries are users. By default all people; with Active Directory: (&(objectClass=user)(objectCategory=person)).

email_attribute.label: Email attribute
email_attribute.help: The field that holds the email address (used to recognize the person at SSO sign-in).

given_name_attribute.label: First name attribute
given_name_attribute.help: The LDAP field that holds the person's first name.

family_name_attribute.label: Last name attribute
family_name_attribute.help: The LDAP field that holds the person's family name.

id_attribute.label: Stable identifier attribute
id_attribute.help: A field that never changes for a person, to recognize them even if they change name or folder. OpenLDAP: entryUUID; Active Directory: objectGUID.

team_selector.label: Where does the team name come from?
team_selector.help: Teams (accounting, HR, purchasing…) let you target a campaign in one go. They can come from the directory's groups, or from a field filled in on each person (their department, their organizational unit…).

options.attribute: An attribute of each person (e.g. department)
options.container: The folder (OU) the person is in

group_filter.label: Group filter
group_filter.help: Which entries are groups (one team = one group). Leave empty if teams do not come from groups.

member_attribute.label: Members attribute
member_attribute.help: In a group, the field that lists its members (their DNs).

team_attribute.label: Attribute that gives the team
team_attribute.help: The field of each person whose value is the team name. Used if you chose "an attribute".

secret.label: Bind account password
secret.help: The password of the read-only service account. Encrypted here, never displayed again.

smtp.label: SMTP
smtp.description: Sends through any SMTP server: an internal relay (Postfix, Exchange…) or a provider's SMTP service. The connection can be encrypted (TLS or STARTTLS).

host.label: SMTP server
host.help: The address of the server that sends the emails.

port.label: Port
port.help: The server's port: 587 (STARTTLS, the most common), 465 (implicit TLS) or 25.

use_starttls.label: STARTTLS
use_starttls.help: Encrypts the connection after opening it (port 587). Tick unless the server does not allow it.

use_tls.label: Implicit TLS
use_tls.help: Encrypts the connection as soon as it opens (port 465). Cannot be combined with STARTTLS.

username.label: User
username.help: The account that authenticates with the server. Leave empty if the server does not require authentication (internal relay).

from_address.label: Sender address
from_address.help: The address that appears as the sender of the signature emails.

reply_to.label: Reply to
reply_to.help: Optional: the address that receives replies (the sender is often not read).

secret.label: SMTP password
secret.help: The password of the account above. Encrypted here, never displayed again. Leave empty if the server does not require authentication.

graph.label: Microsoft 365 (Graph)
graph.description: Sends from a mailbox of your Microsoft 365 tenant with the application registered in Entra (Mail.Send permission of type Application, with administrator consent). Restrict it to that single mailbox with an Exchange access policy.

graph_tenant_id.label: Tenant ID
graph_tenant_id.help: The identifier of your Microsoft directory: Entra → Overview → "Tenant ID".

graph_client_id.label: Application (client) ID
graph_client_id.help: The identifier of the application registered in Entra (App registrations → "Application (client) ID"). It is neither the object ID nor the secret ID.

from_address.label: Dedicated sending mailbox
from_address.help: The mailbox (preferably a shared, unlicensed one) on whose behalf the emails are sent. It must exist in your tenant.

reply_to.label: Reply to
reply_to.help: Optional: the address that receives replies.

secret.label: Client secret
secret.help: The VALUE of the secret created in Entra → Certificates & secrets (the "Value" column). Encrypted here, never displayed again.

gmail.label: Google Workspace (Gmail)
gmail.description: Sends from a mailbox of your Google Workspace domain with a service account authorized through domain-wide delegation, for the "gmail.send" scope only (Admin console → Security → Access and data control → API controls).

from_address.label: Sending mailbox
from_address.help: The Gmail mailbox on whose behalf the emails are sent: the service account acts for it. It must exist in your Google Workspace domain.

reply_to.label: Reply to
reply_to.help: Optional: the address that receives replies.

secret.label: Service account key (JSON)
secret.help: The content of the JSON file downloaded from Google Cloud (IAM → Service accounts → Keys → Create key). Encrypted here, never displayed again.
